name: Report Transaction Response 8
definition: Content of the Transaction Report Response message.

ReportFullSize.name: Report Full Size
ReportFullSize.definition: Specifies the total number of transactions matching the search criteria.

BlockStart.name: Block Start
BlockStart.definition: Index of the first transaction reported in this message within the list of transactions matching the search criteria.

BlockStop.name: Block Stop
BlockStop.definition: Index of the last transaction reported in this message.

TransactionReport.name: Transaction Report
TransactionReport.definition: List of Transaction Report containing one Transaction Report for each transaction matching the Search criteria. This list may be partial according to requested block.
